verdict.rationale: Supabase's docs explicitly document CLI telemetry opt-out via `supabase telemetry disable`, an env var (SUPABASE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1), and respecting the DO_NOT_TRACK convention, directly satisfying the opt-out story for the AI-native CLI/agent workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that opt-out actually stops data collection, and coverage of telemetry opt-out for other surfaces (Dashboard/Studio, hosted MCP server) beyond the CLI.
